name: Tallonkai's Jewel
summary: On Teldrassil, Tallonkai's Jewel is lost from its druidic talisman. Ferocitas the Dream Eater prizes the emerald, which is needed to mend the Emerald Dreamcatcher.

sections.title: A Stolen Core
sections.body: Tallonkai Swiftroot received the Emerald Dreamcatcher from Gaerolas Talvethen, warden of the druids in the Ban'ethil Barrow Den. The talisman is a powerful focus that draws energy from the Emerald Dream. When it was damaged, someone pried its radiant central emerald free and carried it into eastern Teldrassil. Ferocitas the Dream Eater, a corrupted Gnarlpine leader, took the jewel and made it into a necklace. Its green light glimmered in the forest gloom, but its harmony with the Emerald Dream meant nothing to the furbolg. To Ferocitas, it was only a trophy until it could be recovered.

faq.answer: Tallonkai's Jewel is an enchanted emerald and the centerpiece of the Emerald Dreamcatcher, a druidic focus Gaerolas Talvethen gave to Tallonkai Swiftroot of Dolanaar.
Ferocitas the Dream Eater stole the jewel. He leads the corrupted Gnarlpine mystics living north of Starbreeze Village.

faq.q: Can the Gnarlpine furbolgs use the jewel's power?
faq.answer: No. Ferocitas wore the emerald as a glowing necklace, but its druidic power was useless to the corrupted furbolg.

faq.q: Where does the jewel go after it is recovered?
faq.answer: The jewel goes back to Tallonkai Swiftroot on Dolanaar's upper tier, where he uses it to mend and fully restore the Emerald Dreamcatcher.

angles.text: As a druid, you know the emerald is attuned to the Emerald Dream. Its misuse by corrupted furbolgs affronts the balance.
As a night elf, you help restore order to Teldrassil by taking sacred craftwork from the encroaching Gnarlpine.
